newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: ARGENTINE CASH MAIZE ENDS MAINLY FIRMER.
newsitem.headline: ARGENTINE CASH MAIZE ENDS MAINLY FIRMER.

text.p: Argentine cash maize closed mainly firmer in good volume at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange Wednesday, with exporters buying enthusiastically, traders said.

FAS elevator maize rose $1 to $106 for delivery to Rosario, Bahia Blanca or Quequen, but was steady at $106 for Buenos Aires. FAS elevator soybeans rose $4 to $274 for delivery to the port of Rosario, in moderate volume trade following price rises in Chicago. Rosario sunflower seed was unchanged at $220 in thin trade.
